summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Manicure Gardening Services marketing site. Backend pytest suite (5 tests) 100% pass: seeded reviews GET, review POST + persistence, review invalid rating (422), estimate POST + list persistence, estimate invalid email (422). Frontend Playwright covered hero heading, nav links smooth-scroll, header call button, reviews section (5 seeded cards visible initially -> 6 after posting), review dialog form submission (rating star, name, text), estimate form submission with service+property dropdowns showing success state. All flows work end-to-end.

issues: Missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby (a11y warning in console) - non-blocking

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to review dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is used inside seed_reviews() but defined AFTER the startup handler is registered. It still works because startup runs after module import completes, but the ordering is fragile - move logging config above route/handler definitions.
server.py: SEED_REVIEWS uses str(uuid.uuid4()) evaluated at import time, so seeding re-creates same IDs on every process boot (fine since guarded by count==0, but worth noting).
No rate-limiting or basic profanity/length caps on public /api/reviews POST or /api/estimates POST - open to spam abuse in production.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 4 reviews on startup; tests added 1 TEST_ review and 1 TEST_ estimate (left in DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL from frontend/.env used for testing. All 5 pytest tests pass. Frontend flows all pass with data-testids as documented. Lenis smooth scroll works with element.scrollIntoView (Header uses this).
